abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 2. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.0 | 4.5 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 9.2 | 4.6 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 9.6 | 4.8 | 450 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
